lots.guide_summary: Close entries run AU$35 to AU$574. Sold: Fortuna (US dealer room, 2026, apparently premium-inclusive) Cartier Must pieces US$219 to US$375 (AU$335 to AU$574 at an assumed 1.53) and one Australian LV Taiga/Epi long wallet at AU$35 (2024, outside the window). Unsold: none. Asking: eBay and Gumtree snippets AU$100 to AU$246, unverified. Tasmanian category guide: a Burberry wallet made $85 hammer at Gowans. No same-model sold result found for either the LV pocket organiser or the Cartier bifold.
lots.working: No SOLD entry is the same item: the Cartier sales are long, trifold or coin-purse formats, mostly boxed, from an authenticating US dealer room, and the only LV result is a different model 28 months ago at AU$35. Authenticity of both branded pieces is unverified from one photo. So keep_max = 0 and flip_max = 0 under the rules. For context only, not a bid: if both prove genuine, a Tasmanian or eBay AU resale of perhaps AU$150 to AU$300 for the pair looks plausible, but that rests on asking prices.
lots.confidence_reason: Logos read, but no date code or serial seen and no same-model sold result; sold support is US close-model and undated beyond 2026, the rest asking or snippet.

lots.condition: Used. Cartier shows creasing and edge wear; LV looks lightly used. No boxes, dust bags or papers. Interiors of the Cartier not shown.
lots.question_for_armitage: Can you check inside the Louis Vuitton for a date code (two letters and four digits in a pocket seam) and inside the Cartier for the Cartier Paris stamp and serial number, and say whether either has boxes or papers? Is there any brand on the black card holder? Any tears or peeling inside?
